cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The rooftop light is right for the dress. Through the staff-only door first, please; I'll follow with the camera.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the bride. They'll notice me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Being noticed is rather the point of a bridal portrait. Chin up, and don't bunch the train in your hands.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then walk beside me and carry it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The train needs the doorway to itself. I'll hold the end; you go through first, slowly, before I bring the camera in.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 sets the photographic objective, A3 corrects posture and train handling, A5 uses precise doorway procedure to keep B crossing the restriction first.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 visibility fear causes A3 portrait reinterpretation; B4 asks beside-and-carry support and A5 accepts train support while rejecting side-by-side entry.

relationship.evidence: B4 tries to make A share first exposure, a plausible response to the photographer pressure.

heightening.evidence: A5 converts B4 demand into a professional handling reason for the original first-entry order.

specificity.evidence: A1 staff-only rooftop access and B2 bride make the rule and conspicuous person explicit.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 measured slowly and camera-after order carry strained procedural control without a generic expertise claim.
